endangerment.comment: Senaya (5432-syn) = Endangered (60 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [McPherson and Caldani 2013](cldf:mcpherson:caldani:13)

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Senaya [syn] is listed in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 as a separate Christian Neo-Aramaic language of Sanandaj in Iran. But this variety is closely related to the subgroup of Suleimaniyya Christian dialects (**hh:hv:Khan:Neo-Aramaic-Iran**:447-448) of the Chaldean Neo-Aramaic [cld] entry and does not warrant a separate entry. See also: Chaldean Neo-Aramaic [cld].
